articles.title: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
articles.excerpt: In this report, we introduce the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and present Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time. articles.summary: 现有交互模型多为单向响应，难以支撑实时全双工交互。本文提出 Reciprocal World Model（RWM），将智能与物理现实视为同等基础，并给出全双工世界模型 Duo v1，可持续感知音视频输入并实时回应用户。

articles.title: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
articles.excerpt: Video generation models produce visually realistic videos but still struggle with physical dynamics and causal consistency. Learning from generated videos requires fine-grained physical supervision, yet reliable quality judgments, correction pairs, and controlled variations are difficult to obtain.
articles.summary: 视频生成模型画面逼真，却常违背物理动力学与因果一致性。本文提出 PhysLoop，利用 LLM 的物理常识对生成视频做细粒度质量判断与纠错，构造可靠的校正对与受控变化样本，使视频生成模型实现自我改进。

articles.title: On the Design of Hyper-Connections: Simplification, Stability, and Scalability
articles.excerpt: Hyper-Connections (HC) architectures are increasingly adopted in frontier language models, yet their components remain insufficiently understood and introduce non-negligible training overhead. articles.summary: Hyper-Connections（HC）已被前沿语言模型采用，但其各组件缺乏充分理解且带来不可忽视的训练开销。本文系统分析 HC 架构，识别可简化的组件并给出更稳定、可扩展的设计，在保持性能的同时降低训练开销。

articles.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents
articles.excerpt: Decision models answer a question with a typed output, such as a choice among options with a probability for each, so one model can choose an agent's actions, evaluate actions already taken, or score every action to teach a policy with reinforcement learning. articles.title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading of External Content for AI Agents

articles.title: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models

articles.title: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference

articles.title: Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale

articles.title: GTAGym: AAA Game Tasks Environment for Evaluation and Reinforcement Learning
